## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The new flag should honor `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE`, because environment-configured exclusions currently have no effect and violate the CLI policy.

## Changes
The pull request adds repeatable filename-glob exclusions, skip logging, flag documentation, and parser and archive tests. This review read the tests without running them.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Read the exclusion default from ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE — With `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE=*.log` and no `--exclude`, your parser returns `[]` and archives matching logs. `.agents/skills/cli-flags/reference.md:5` requires every new flag to “take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable.” — CI jobs configuring exclusions through the environment include files they intended to omit, violating the required flag interface.
